About The Role

Shape Places, Influence Communities, Deliver Positive Change

Join a dynamic Planning Service where you'll play a key role in shaping the future of North Northamptonshire. Working across Planning Policy, Development Management and Enforcement, you will lead and support a range of planning projects, helping to develop planning policies, guidance and evidence that influence how the area grows and develops. Alongside this, you will manage planning applications and appeals, provide expert advice to customers and colleagues, and investigate breaches of planning control, taking appropriate enforcement action where required. This varied role offers the opportunity to make a tangible impact on local communities by supporting sustainable development, protecting environmental quality and ensuring a fair, effective and trusted planning system.

What will you be doing?

Support senior planning officers and managers in delivering Planning Service objectives.
Provide excellent customer service and respond to planning-related enquiries.
Contribute to service improvements, process reviews and system enhancements.
Maintain up-to-date knowledge of planning legislation, policies and best practice.
Produce accurate, high-quality work within agreed timescales.
Attend evening and weekend meetings, committees and public consultation events.
Assist in developing planning policies, design guidance and Local Plan documents.
Undertake research and gather evidence to support policy development and place-shaping initiatives.
Engage with communities, stakeholders and partners through consultations and public events.
Analyse planning data, monitor trends and maintain planning databases and monitoring systems.
Provide planning policy advice on applications, corporate projects and infrastructure planning.
Prepare reports, statements and evidence for planning appeals, examinations and legal proceedings.
Support the procurement and management of specialist planning consultants.
Help develop and utilise planning technology, including Geographic Information Systems (GIS).
Validate planning applications and process planning submissions.
Manage a caseload of planning applications and planning enforcement investigations.
Conduct site visits, consultations and assessments, making recommendations in line with planning policy.
Prepare and present reports for Planning Committee meetings.
Negotiate improvements to development proposals.
Advise applicants, developers, residents and stakeholders on planning matters.
Work collaboratively with internal departments and external organisations to achieve positive planning outcomes.
Represent the Council at hearings, inquiries and court proceedings where required.
Assist with complaints handling and support investigations undertaken by the Local Government Ombudsman.

About You

A relevant degree or equivalent qualification to allow future access to Chartered membership of the Royal Town Planning Institute (or equivalent).
Demonstration of a Personal Development Plan that explains a commitment via Licentiate, Associate or the Experienced Practitioner route, to achieving Chartered Membership of the Royal Town Planning Institute (or equivalent).
Conversant with policy documents, plans, maps and architectural drawings.
Understanding of the English Planning System.
Experience of using computer databases, and Microsoft packages such as PowerPoint, Excel, Word and Outlook
Good communication skills
Report writing skills
Able to deliver excellent customer service under pressure
Good organisational skills
Able to travel independently to multiple sites across the Council’s administrative area to undertake site visits on a frequent basis (3-5 times a week), or further away to attend meetings and events on behalf of the Council. For example, the ability to drive with access to own transport.
Good time management skills
The ability to carry out site visits or investigations on a variety of outdoor door locations including domestic properties, overgrown site with uneven ground conditions, and building sites

As partners to all areas of the business, we work to empower every team to do the best work of their lives while making HUMAN one of the best places to work. Customer Success is at the core of HUMAN’s operations. We’re looking for a Solution Engineer to join our team to manage the complete end-to-end integration process for our clients, working across all our Advertising and Cybersecurity products. The relationship you build with your clients have a direct impact on our product - both in the short and long term to ensure the needs of the client are heard and met. Operates as the primary technical contact for HUMAN’s clients during product integration, taking the lead on coordinating development efforts, running client version upgrades and migrations, troubleshooting technical issues, and reporting discrepancies as they are surfaced.
Be hyper responsive to team and client inquiries that demand immediate attention and quick turnaround time.
Work with HUMAN’s Sales, Product, Operations, Engineering and Detection teams to deploy, configure and troubleshoot services for clients.
Develop technical documentation, both internally and externally, that empower customers to self-serve and improve their own integrations with HUMAN.
Be a front line product expert. Demonstrate the ability to present and explain, in detail, how HUMAN’s products and services function to a variety of audiences from product and engineering to CEO and leadership members.
Individually manage multiple simultaneous projects and track tasks to completion.
Become a student of your Client List - understand your clients infrastructure and services - identify where HUMAN’s products best fit.
Cultivate collaborative relationships with Sales and Product leads to feed back client feature requirements into our products and services.
Vigilantly protect the confidentiality and privacy of client data.
Be Human: Acclimate yourself to HUMAN culture and help us grow even more!

Requirements

Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or Information Technology Systems.
Has been a Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer or Technical Account Manager experienced within Media and Advertising, and wants to be a part of creating and evolving new and emerging HUMAN Products.
Foundational knowledge of Open Real-Time Bidding (RTB) lifecycle, IVT terminology, VAST, and understanding how a bid request travels from SSP to DSP and the role of HUMAN’s products along the journey.
Knowledge or experience working with viewability and brand-safety products for AdTech companies.
Familiarity working with advertising transparency standards such as ads.txt, app-apds.txt, and sellers.json files.
Experience with Programming and Scripting Skills such as HTML, Javascript, Java, Go, C++, Python, Shell, Node.js
Ability to query datasets in Snowflake to validate integrations, help investigate IVT patterns, and troubleshoot client integrations.
Familiarity with web troubleshooting tools such as: Chrome DevTools, Postman, Swagger, Fiddler, APIs, etc.
Familiarity with server, networking, and public/private cloud technologies (e.g., AWS, GCP).
Experience working with JIRA and Confluence, and writing technical documentation for internal employees and external customers.

HUMAN was founded in a Brooklyn sci-fi bookstore with a hacker mindset and the lofty mission of making the internet safer by putting humans first. We support our Humans with a comprehensive total rewards package for personal and professional development, including well-being and learning stipends, flexible work options, and dedicated time off. While our HQ is in NYC, we have teams worldwide.

HUMAN is growing fast, and there’s never been a more meaningful time to join us. If you thrive on solving complex problems and want to help shape the future of cybersecurity, join us as we build a safer, more human internet.

In this role, you will effectively manage, develop and grow a portfolios whilst adding excellent customer service and deepening relationships.

To be successful as a Customer Success Manager you should have:

Knowledge of industry trends and market developments
Understanding and experience in Payments
Relationship management and interpersonal skills to include, experience in achieving credibility and building strong client relationships at all levels
Negotiation skills and a successful track record of increasing business performance amongst clients with the ability to negotiate at strategic level and ‘close a deal’ successfully with maximum business benefit
Influencing ability and ability to adapt and prioritise in a fast-paced environment

Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include

Experience in the Business to Business Financial Services Sector
Experience managing a portfolio
Knowledge of relevant third party suppliers (e.g. technology), partners and key competitors

You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills

This role will cover UK-Wide and can be based in Northampton or London and will require regular travel across the UK.

Barclays’ payments acceptance business provides critical infrastructure to the UK economy, processing billions of pounds of payments annually for both small businesses and domestic and international corporate clients.

In April 2025, we announced a long-term partnership with Brookfield Asset Management to grow and transform the payments acceptance business by broadening the range of services offered, enhancing the experience for both existing and prospective clients. Leveraging extensive client relationships and deep experience of UK payments, we will create an environment of continuous innovation - activated by Brookfield’s global private equity expertise in payments, technology, operational transformation and corporate carve-outs - to ensure the business is strategically positioned for long-term growth.

Barclays will invest approximately £400m in the new business, the majority of which will be incurred during the first three years. Performance-linked incentives will drive greater alignment between the partners, underpinning the long-term commitment to the transformation. Barclays and Brookfield will work to create a standalone entity over time, continuing to use the Barclaycard Payments (BPL) brand and acting as the sole payments acceptance services provider to Barclays’ clients for a minimum of ten years.

For more information on our partnership with Brookfield, please visit Barclays.com .

To establish and nurture profitable relationships with both corporate and individual clients. It's the bridge between the bank's offerings and clients' needs, ensuring mutual benefit and long-term success.

Management of client relationships to identify the client's financial goals, challenges, and risk tolerance to support the analysis of data obtained from various sources, including the investment portfolio and cash flow, to identify trends, insights, areas for improvement and additional services to support client needs.
Research and understanding of the client's industry trends, regulatory landscape, and competitive environment to inform strategic recommendations.
Design of customised solutions that address the client's specific needs and objectives, incorporating a range of products and services from the bank's portfolio.
Communication of the value proposition of proposed solutions, justification of recommendations, and negotiation of terms that are beneficial for both the client and the bank.
Provision of guidance to clients to support their financial decisions, offering expert investment advice, risk management and wealth management strategies support, and updates on market trends to ensure a positive and continuous relationship.
Assessment of financial, legal, and operational risks associated with client relationships, and implementation of measures to minimise potential losses.
Documentation of all client interactions, transactions, and agreements to ensure transparency and auditability, and communicate findings effectively to support product development, service offerings, and the overall bank strategy.
Monitoring of client satisfaction, revenue generated, and other relevant metrics to evaluate the effectiveness of relationship management efforts.

To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes

new_jobs.description:
An Amazing Career Opportunity for a Customer Success Adoption Manager!!

Location:
Austin, Texas

Job ID:
51699

The Customer Success Adoption Manager owns customer adoption and operational performance for HID's EDI, Webshop, and Customer Command Center tools. The role guides customers through onboarding, change, and ongoing optimization; manages escalations; and turns customer and operational insights into measurable improvements.

Who are we?

HID powers the trusted identities of the world’s people, places, and things, allowing people to transact safely, work productively and travel freely.

We are a high-tech software company headquartered in Austin, TX, with over 4,500 worldwide employees. Check us out here: www.hidglobal.com and https://youtu.be/23km5H4K9Eo

Physical Access Control Solutions (PACS):

HID Physical Access Control Solutions (PACS) is at the forefront of securing spaces with advanced, reliable access control solutions. From cutting-edge readers, credentials and controllers, to mobile and biometric technologies, HID PACS empowers organizations worldwide to protect their people, property and assets with scalable, high-quality solutions.

This is more than just a job – it’s your chance to join an industry leader to drive innovation in access control and make a real impact on global security solutions.

Are you ready to make a difference? Join us and help shape the future of security.

As our Customer Success Adoption Manager, you’ll support HID’s success by:

Owning the customer experience and operational success of HID's EDI, Webshop, and Customer Command Center tools.
Leading customer onboarding, training, go-live readiness, stabilization, and adoption for assigned digital tools and trading partners.
Serving as the customer-facing owner for incidents and escalations, coordinating communications, business-impact assessments, and resolution follow-through.
Monitoring adoption, access, transaction quality, order holds, processing delays, and recurring customer friction; identifying risks before they escalate.
Partnering with technical teams to resolve data, configuration, mapping, integration, portal, and downstream order-processing issues.
Leading root-cause reviews and corrective actions for recurring issues, with clear owners, due dates, validation, and customer communication.
Coordinating user acceptance testing and business readiness for releases, ERP changes, portal enhancements, and new transaction types.
Creating and maintaining customer-facing and internal enablement materials, including training resources, workflow guidance, and readiness checklists.
Driving adoption of digital and self-service workflows that improve transaction quality, reduce manual work, and improve customer outcomes.
Conducting recurring customer and internal business reviews; translating usage, performance, and feedback into clear improvement actions.
Maintaining customer profiles, trading-partner requirements, access details, escalation paths, test evidence, and change history.
Building health reporting and partner across Sales, NAM PACS Customer Operations, Order Management, Supply Chain, Product, and Technology to improve the end-to-end experience.

Your Experience and Background include:

Bachelor's degree in business, supply chain, information systems, operations, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Two or more years of experience in customer success, digital customer platforms, e-commerce, EDI, technical account management, order management, B2B integration, or supply-chain operations.
Experience owning customer adoption, utilization, health, and operational performance for customer-facing technology or digital tools.
Working knowledge of EDI transaction flows and web-based customer tools, including onboarding, access, order processing, issue management, and user enablement.
Demonstrated experience managing customer incidents, cross-functional escalations, root-cause analysis, and corrective actions.
Experience leading operational reviews, change management, user acceptance testing, or readiness planning for systems and process changes.
Strong analytical skills and the ability to use customer, adoption, transaction, and operational data to identify trends and measure results.
Clear communication, documentation, facilitation, prioritization, and follow-through skills, with the ability to influence cross-functional teams without direct authority.
Experience with ERP, CRM, ticketing, e-commerce, customer portal, analytics, or order-management systems.
Experience with EDI mapping, partner certification, integration platforms, ANSI X12 transactions, VAN, AS2, SFTP, APIs, or managed file transfer is preferred.
Experience supporting distributors, resellers, manufacturers, or complex B2B supply chains is preferred.

What we can offer you:

Competitive salary and rewards package
Competitive benefits and annual leave offering, allowing for work-life balance
A vibrant, welcoming & inclusive culture
Extensive career development opportunities and resources to maximize your potential
To be a part of a global organization that is pioneering the hardware, software and services that allow people to confidently navigate the physical and digital worlds

Why apply?

Empowerment: You’ll work as part of a global team in a flexible work environment, learning and enhancing your expertise. We welcome an opportunity to meet you and learn about your unique talents, skills, and experiences. You don’t need to check all the boxes. If you have most of the skills and experience, we want you to apply.
Innovation: You embrace challenges and want to drive change. You'll have opportunities to share insights and contribute forward-thinking ideas that shape future outcomes.
Integrity: You are results-orientated, reliable, and straightforward and value being treated accordingly. We want all our employees to be themselves, to feel appreciated and accepted.

We make it easier for people to get where they want to go!

On an average day, think of how many times you tap, twist, tag, push or swipe to get access, find information, connect with others or track something. HID technology is behind billions of interactions, in more than 100 countries. We help you create a verified, trusted identity that can get you where you need to go – without having to think about it.

When you join our HID team, you’ll also be part of the ASSA ABLOY Group, the global leader in access solutions. You’ll have 63,000 colleagues in more than 70 different countries. We empower our people to build their career around their aspirations and our ambitions – supporting them with regular feedback, training, and development opportunities. Our colleagues think broadly about where they can make the most impact, and we encourage them to grow their role locally, regionally, or even internationally. As we welcome new people on board, it’s important to us to have diverse, inclusive teams, and we value different perspectives and experiences.
